'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Michael Pistone DS Drop''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Michael Pistone]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Forest Clearing|Endor-D-endorforestclearing.gif}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
